settings.desc: Hide-on-scroll hides the header as you scroll down and reveals it on scroll up. Reduced-motion visitors get a plain always-sticky header.

settings.label: Frosted glass background

settings.label: Background video
settings.desc: Optional muted autoplay loop over the image. Hidden for visitors who prefer reduced motion, so set a background image as the fallback.

settings.label: Background video (mobile)
settings.desc: Optional loop shown at ≤749px in place of the background video. Requires a background video to be set.

settings.label: Content width
settings.desc: Readable measure caps the copy at about 40rem, which suits centred copy over an image. Full width suits a two-column split, such as copy beside a data table.

settings.label: Placeholder image
settings.desc: Shows a stock illustration when no background media is set. Turn off for a deliberately media-less banner.

settings.label: Text overlay opacity
settings.desc: Darkens the media behind the copy for AA contrast. 100% = the AA-tested scrim.

settings.label: Horizontal position (mobile)
settings.desc: Banner layout only. "Same as desktop" keeps the desktop position.

settings.label: Vertical position (mobile)

settings.label: Show a tagged product on the tile

settings.label: Caption style
settings.desc: Card is the default surface. Accent fills the caption with the accent color; set caption heading and text blocks to the "On accent" color for readable contrast, since block-level color settings override the band.
